deck_quality_attestations.commander_first: Exact-current 99 singleton physical library verified, 26 land sources, 19 project Game Changers, exactly Evelyn+Insolent Neonate as two Vampire card names. Evelyn ETB or other Vampire exiles top card each player's library with collection counter, with a once-per-turn per-live-source permission to play eligible collected exiles. Historical K1 global cap across multiple Evelyn copies is not independently proven; no claim of a global one or automatic unlimited copies.
deck_quality_attestations.mana_and_protection: cEDH color/Ritual/mox 26-land shell favors fast fetches Marsh Flats/Verdant and Brainstorm but pays life and loses Spellskite/Redirect direct protection. Burnt Offering must sacrifice owned controlled creature, e.g. Evelyn MV5, for genuine B/R mana; it is no free land. Vexing Bauble can counter our own Force/Negation/Pact/Gitaxian Probe when no mana was spent; requires deliberate sacrifice before free spell. Hard counters, Defense Grid, Hexing and Stifle remain.
deck_quality_attestations.win_lines_and_counterplay: Worldgorger/Animate Dead, Dance or Necromancy requires repeated legal stack and a true loop exit; no exit produces forced game draw, and Evelyn may exile our finite own deck. Insolent Neonate needs actual discard card and sacrifice to exit and can be disrupted. Oracle+Consultation/Pact and Breach+LED/Petal+Brain Freeze depend on real grave/exile/library constraints and opponent interaction. No certified cEDH statistical win rate.
deck_quality_attestations.historical_M6_case_scope: Five original P0 C1/K1/K2/K3/F1 and nine P1 K4/K5/E1/E2/W1/W2/W3/F2/F3 are mapped to adversarial current-source case rows. K1 absolute across-all-Evelyns inference is preserved as unproven instead of falsely certified. Original firstpass five-swap Grok J, archival Spellbook and selected Scryfall are not magically a new independent whole-deck J.
deck_quality_attestations.tested_pool_stop_reason: Independent scrutiny supported precisely five real swaps: two fetches, Neonate, Brainstorm and Burnt Offering. Six-swap alternatives reintroducing owner-excluded tribal package or cutting Ripples/Praetor's Grasp for Spell Pierce, Grim Monolith, Intuition or Daze do not justify losing owner-kept cards and true Worldgorger exit.

deck_quality_attestations.commander_first: Exact-current 99 library singleton physical source, 26 possible land faces including Sink into Stupor MDFC and 20 game changers. Azula firebending RR lasts only through combat, and only real spells CAST while attacking generate stack copies; copies are not cast. Flash enablers/haste allow instant attack-window setup, while copied permanents become token on resolution rather than new token-creation effect.
deck_quality_attestations.mana_and_protection: 26-land cEDH shell swaps often-rainbow Exotic Orchard for blue MDFC that requires paying three life to enter untapped, reducing front spell Ad Nauseam quality. Turnabout/Flashback/Samut Hazoret improve attacking spell copy ceiling, but cutting prior split-second Samut Tyrant and Redirect Lightning loses real protection. Hexing Squelcher, Cavern/Gemstone, Swan, Force, Fluster remain; Mox Opal metalcraft and colored URB timing constrain early attack.
deck_quality_attestations.win_lines_and_counterplay: Electrodominance copy+original at X=2 can each cast eligible nonland hand spell free on resolution when legal target persists; attack copies apply to those newly cast spells only while Azula remains attacking. Illegal Electro target fizzles each instance, no free cast, and neither repeated legal targets nor full hand is guaranteed. Big Score paid additional discard once and copy inherits payment, letting two resolving instances each draw two/make two Treasure. Narset's Reversal/Turnabout, Breach, Oracle remain conditional, not automatic infinity or sampled win rate.
deck_quality_attestations.historical_M6_case_scope: Five original P0 C1/K1/K2/K3/F1 and nine P1 K4/K5/E1/E2/W1/W2/W3/F2/F3 reconciled to fourteen bounded source-specific favorable/adverse cases. Official Wizards Azula and Electro release notes support cast-vs-copy and timing. Research-only M6 I/J and finite mana-access proxy remain distinct from current independently executed certification.
deck_quality_attestations.tested_pool_stop_reason: Five owner-approved Oct24 changes selected from five complete alternatives; sixth Mistrise Village over fetch, restored split-second Samut, Windfall over Vivi and Grok's Swan/Gemstone cuts each degrade early mana or stack interaction. No unapproved sixth cut recommended.

deck_quality_attestations.commander_first: Current exact 99 singleton library matched, 37 conventional lands plus Malakir Mire tapland face = 38 possible land plays, 11 acceleration rocks and 20 real Equipment. Garza is flying haste seven-mana 5/5; Garza-source damage to enemy creature followed by death in same turn grows counters; combat damage to player draws optionally. Lizard Blades plus Two-Handed Axe build genuine commander damage, but unblocked first combat base five → Axe ten → double strike twenty, short of 21.
deck_quality_attestations.mana_and_protection: Two-Handed Axe Adventure and equipment are a SINGLE card. Conqueror's Flail equipped to three-color Garza gives +3/+3 and stops opponents casting spells on our turn, not responding before equip/activating abilities. Malakir Rebirth returns Garza only after real death and if kept in graveyard; new object tapped, old counters/equipment gone. Tapped Mire replacing untapped Takenuma reduces early colored speed. Seven-mana castability and commander tax demand 11 rocks, which were all retained.
deck_quality_attestations.win_lines_and_counterplay: Grafted Exoskeleton +2/+2 grants infect: Axe with 7 power doubles to 14 poison on real connection; Kediss spreads GARZA-SOURCED noncombat infect damage to other opponents but not commander combat damage. The Ozolith gains counter equivalents on departure but does not transfer Equipment. Jeska starting loyalty depends on actual command-zone casts, not Command Beacon hand cast. Seize/Assault extra combats need real legal target, R mana, Sword/Reaver connection and phase timing; no guaranteed infinite.
deck_quality_attestations.historical_M6_case_scope: Five original P0 C1/K1/K2/K3/F1 and nine P1 K4/K5/E1/E2/W1/W2/W3/F2/F3 reconciled into fourteen favorable and adversarial current source cases. Bounded damage, Jeska count, equipment and Malakir tests do not recertify earlier four-swap formal I/J as current seven-swap pass.
deck_quality_attestations.tested_pool_stop_reason: Seven approved Rev2 swaps challenged Scythe attachment reanimation, Inquisitor Flail, expensive Robe, Rapid/Edict interaction, Takenuma and alternate MDFCs. Alternatives cutting Fellwar or Orchard weaken this seven-mana Voltron commander more than unique combat upside. No extra unapproved changes.

deck_quality_attestations.commander_first: Abaddon's cascade happens only for own-turn spells actually cast from hand after total life lost across opponents reaches the card's mana value. This exact 34-land 95-name Rev3 preserves Warhammer printed cascade, Nalfeshnee, copied Abaddon via Sakashima, Boltwave/Flame Rift/Stone Fangs thresholds, 1BR Mount Doom and protected Grinning Ignus/Birgi/Familiar/Impact recursion, Neheb plus Assault and Sheoldred Wheel as contingent finishers.
deck_quality_attestations.mana_and_protection: Thirty-four lands, 3 Island, 2 Mountain, 3 Swamp, true untapped colored fetch/dual access, three Talismans, fast temporary resources and mana-value timing require real five-mana paid commander casts and additional spells. Mount Doom has paid 1BR activation, Sanctum requires an upkeep, and Rule of Law, Drannith, free counters, removal and Breach graveyard hate genuinely obstruct the cascade chain.
deck_quality_attestations.win_lines_and_counterplay: Ignus/Birgi/Familiar produces net generic mana only after legitimate repeat cost/activation, with Impact creature-enter damage needed for opponent kill; Neheb plus Assault needs prior combat life loss and 3RR payment; copied Abaddon multiplies qualifying cascade but does not turn nonhand spells into hand casts. Printed Noise Marine and Call Forth remain distinctive native cascade regardless of commander survival.
deck_quality_attestations.historical_M6_case_scope: No original M6 preimplementation blueprint exists for Abaddon alongside the four later design blueprints. Fourteen newly composed exact-current bounded cases (5 P0/9 P1) in report scope the complex formerly tested M7 Stage20 and archived I/J separately; neither the older 92/92 engineering result nor the present fixtures are independently witnessed current multiplayer wins or unconditional current J.
deck_quality_attestations.tested_pool_stop_reason: October23 specifically owner-approved six-swap Rev3 from four deep 100-card alternatives and EDHREC/Scryfall challengers; extra Ojer/Veyran/Greaves/Warhammer seventh changes cost paid mana reduction, spell-stack protection or native 40K engine. No quality-positive change exceeds those known protected losses. Keep exact owner-approved source.

deck_quality_attestations.commander_first: Thirty-three lands, fresh attacking Ninjas and Hanweir Human attackers, Bitterblossom flyers, Breath of Fury and repeated combats support exactly one Dragon per damaged player per combat damage step from fresh creatures. Human-chosen Roaming Throne doubles Goro triggered abilities and Hanweir's own Human trigger where legal, not the number of creature hits or enchantment triggers.
deck_quality_attestations.mana_and_protection: Thirty-three true lands with only Island twice, three Talismans, Fellwar, Sol Ring, real duals/fetches and 1R commander haste costs. New post-damage Dragons do not inherit a haste activation that resolved earlier, and low-toughness Hanweir tokens still need connection against blockers. Greaves, free permission and board answers are payable interactions, not protection guarantees.
deck_quality_attestations.win_lines_and_counterplay: Breath of Fury needs enchanted creature's actual connecting damage, sacrifice, a valid new Aura host and a hasty/able new attacker for each extra combat; no automatic loop. Dragon Tempest/Terror burn needs actual token creations. Aggravated Assault/Karlach/Great Train Heist independently provide finite combats and may cost additional red mana/targets.
deck_quality_attestations.historical_M6_case_scope: Original Goro design-only M6 preimplementation blueprint has five P0 and nine P1 groups; all are reconciled with a positive/current failure premise in the report. The eight/four candidate comparisons and nine independent research checks do not retroactively yield fresh current J or measured multiplayer win rates.
deck_quality_attestations.tested_pool_stop_reason: Owner-approved Bitterblossom/Roaming Throne/Hanweir plus two early fetch upgrades beat alternative Kaito retention/Chandra on repeated attack opportunities but lose Kaito filtering, Grim Hireling independent Treasure and basic/fixed tap lands. Preserve unique Ninja combat drawing and no filler sixth recommendation.

deck_quality_attestations.commander_first: Gwendlyn is targeted random one-card discard only during controller's turn; Sting's own combat untap, Pemmin, Minamo, Bracers and Rings make repeatable tap-discard possible. Rings paid 2 plus Bracers gives three total original+copy effects, not four. Waste Not/Geth/Caress/Tinybones/Bloodchief payoff only on real qualifying discard/grave events; she is not just a generic wheel shell.
deck_quality_attestations.mana_and_protection: Thirty-five actual lands including Island x2 Mountain x1 Swamp x5, improved typed-dual fetches and Shivan U/R cost life or search access; they do not provide unqualified UBBR. Tapped 2+2 Sting equipment and paid untappers require board, mana and a live equipped commander; Lightning Greaves' shroud can block newly targeting Pemmin/Bracers and opponents can remove Gwendlyn.
deck_quality_attestations.win_lines_and_counterplay: Underworld Breach/LED/Wheel remains finite under grave resources; Chains of Mephistopheles applies symmetrically to our own wheel attempts; Bloodchief Ascension cannot Mindcrank-loop when Mindcrank is absent. Hellbent opponents and Oppression's symmetric self-discard inhibit Gwendlyn even if wheel punishment sometimes closes.
deck_quality_attestations.historical_M6_case_scope: Five original P0 and nine P1 blueprint cases are explicitly reconciled with success/failure premises against the exact October24 approved SHA, including old shroud and Chains anti-synergy. Nine prior engineering tests and comparison packets do not turn into fresh whole rules-engine J or multiplayer observed results.
deck_quality_attestations.tested_pool_stop_reason: Owner-approved six cards replace Dauthi, Underworld Dreams, Raven Man, two slower land slots and Mountain. Freed from the Real instead of Sting loses haste; a five-swap no-Shivan alternative loses a blue source. Keeping unique Gwendlyn untap density, wheels and discard synergy outranks another speculative generic replacement.

deck_quality_attestations.commander_first: Inalla's Eminence only nontoken-Wizard entry in the correct Inalla zone and paid 1 makes a single hasty token copy; that token cannot infinitely re-trigger Eminence. Five untapped Wizards can tap for 7 life loss even when summoning sick. Original Spellseeker chain, Scholar recursion, Bloodline/Ruthless, Oracle/Consultation and Breach are separate conditional pathways.
deck_quality_attestations.mana_and_protection: Lean 27-land 100-name turbo cEDH mana includes fast rituals/Mox/LED and colored requirements; Forbidden Orchard makes a blocker and Starting Town is untapped rainbow mainly on turns 1–3, so neither is costless. Force/Pact/Fluster/Swan/REB protect only given actual cards/timing; counter and split-second response windows still matter.
deck_quality_attestations.win_lines_and_counterplay: Gifts Ungiven four-card Spellseeker/Step Through/Reanimate/Unearth split guarantees conditional *access* in all six adversarial two-grave configurations, not a completed deterministic one-card win. Corpse Dance buyback on Scholar needs 4B, top creature graveyard order and real targets; Saw in Half Scholar clones have mana value seven despite smaller P/T; Flashback grave casting still pays normal cost and exiles source.
deck_quality_attestations.historical_M6_case_scope: Original M6 five P0/nine P1 design-only groups reconciled with adverse cases; historical K4 explicitly says Spellseeker deterministic line uncertain, F2 and F3 note Eminence-zone/split-second hazards. Engineering PR #698 6/6 pile/source tests cannot become retrospectively certified I/J or observed wins.
deck_quality_attestations.tested_pool_stop_reason: Owner approved exactly five improved cards vs Kefka, Final Fortune, Wheel of Fortune, Exotic Orchard and Island; losses in Wizard utility, emergency extra turn and immediate wheel refuel disclosed. Pyroblast over REB and sixth speculative options were worse for Inalla-specific Spellseeker access.

deck_quality_attestations.commander_first: Jeleva's entered-from-cast ETB exiles X cards per player with X equal to actual mana spent including paid tax; attack casts one instant/sorcery from exactly that Jeleva object's linked exiles without mana cost. Harmonic Prodigy can double her Wizard ETB/attack triggers, but new Jeleva objects don't inherit old exiles and no attack means no cast.
deck_quality_attestations.mana_and_protection: Twenty-seven physical lands, 45 source instants/sorceries, 20 game changers and ritual/mox package give high velocity with fragile early UBR. Wizard-chosen Cavern helps resolve Jeleva/Oracle only when its restricted mana is spent; removes City's two-generic burst. Lightning Greaves shroud prevents Torch Courier targeting and does not prevent answers to attack abilities.
deck_quality_attestations.win_lines_and_counterplay: Free Fire Covenant still pays X life additional cost, divides targeted damage and can spare Jeleva; it loses Deluge's untargeted shrink and indestructible answer. Staged Mind's Desire/Peer need real linked exiles and attack, while Oracle/Consultation, Doomsday and Breach/LED/Brain Freeze require real zones and protection; casting new Jeleva after Doomsday can exile own pile.
deck_quality_attestations.historical_M6_case_scope: Original Jeleva blueprint five P0/nine P1 each gets exact-current favorable/adverse premise; engineering #699 14 source-bound tests plus 23 whole-100 alternatives are bounded research, not independently observed multiplayer J. The original waiver for just Jeleva permits exactly two owner-approved swaps and does not weaken other decks.
deck_quality_attestations.tested_pool_stop_reason: Cory expressly accepted Jeleva-only two-change five-swap-floor exception after 23 full-100 comparisons. Cavern over City and Fire Covenant over Toxic Deluge improve commander casting and keeping attacking commander alive; adding filler Spellseeker, Savage Beating or Flame of Anor would sacrifice Mnemonic Betrayal, Mind's Desire or free Mindbreak Trap interaction without a proven net gain.
